characters.name: Camera Man – Secret Identity
characters.notes: Costume variant: Change the outfit only: dress the subject in a professional tailored business suit — structured single-breasted blazer with clean lapels, matching dress trousers with a sharp crease, crisp dress shirt, and a refined necktie. Fabrics look premium (smooth wool-blend suit, cotton shirt). Add thick-rimmed eyeglasses with a solid, bold frame. Keep fit natural to the body, correct drape and tailoring, realistic fabric folds and seams. Do not alter face, hair, body, pose, background, or camera.
